lessons_used: Evidence for specific kinds of change is still thin, as no category has at least 2 tests yet.
Predictions have generally been too high compared to noise-corrected results (Rounds 1 and 3), though Round 4 was slightly underestimated.

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Account Creation Order
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step after pet selection and adoption certificate creation so users experience pet creation before creating an account.
candidates.why: Sign in drops 27.1% of users early with a high mean time (567s). Allowing users to pick/create their pet first builds engagement before asking for authentication.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to after adoption certificate creation is explicitly permitted by rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering auth builds engagement early, but requires flow changes.

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Preview Screen
candidates.change: Add an explicit interactive preview screen showing desktop hotkeys, dragging, and pet hiding controls right before completing onboarding.
candidates.why: Support emails show post-onboarding confusion around controlling, hiding, or talking to pets, contributing to a final step drop-off of 35.2%.

new_desktop_controls.headline: How to Interact With Your Desktop Pet
new_desktop_controls.body: Your pet lives directly on your screen! Drag to move, right-click for settings, or press Alt+P to toggle visibility.

components.text: Quick Shortcut: Alt + P toggles pet visibility.

guard.reason: Adding a controls preview screen after home_intro is allowed under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Both funnel and support point to finish confusion, but new screens previously performed poorly.

candidates.title: Grid Pet Selection Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen into a responsive grid view with visual trait badges for quick decision-making.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low 64.8% conversion rate and takes a median 89s / mean 1017s, indicating friction during selection.

guard.reason: Redesigning pet selection screen to a grid layout retains its core job of selecting a pet.

candidates.score_note: High friction step; adoption redesign showed positive results in past test.

candidates.title: Pet Personality Matcher Quiz
candidates.change: Insert a 2-question personality quiz flow right before path selection to help users choose between preset or custom pets.
candidates.why: 23.8% of users abandon at choose_path and take a mean time of 514s, suggesting uncertainty about which adoption path suits them best.

new_personality_quiz.headline: Find Your Perfect Pet Match
new_personality_quiz.body: Answer two quick questions so we can recommend the ideal companion path for your desktop setup.

components.label: What role should your desktop pet play?

guard.reason: Adding a personality quiz sub-flow before path selection is permitted under rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Addresses path drop-off by adding a quiz flow, requiring new screen development.

candidates.title: Account Persistence Reminder Hint
candidates.change: Display a clear account persistence notice on the sign-in screen informing users to use the same provider to retain pets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets being missing or reset after signing in again with a different login method.

sign_in.hint: Tip: Always sign in with the same account provider to keep your adopted pets safe.

guard.reason: Adding an account persistence hint on the sign-in screen complies with all base rules.

candidates.score_note: Fixes user account confusion noted in support; easy copy/hint change.

candidates.title: Wait Screen Progress and Estimate
candidates.change: Enable visual time estimation and background notification toggles while the pet is being prepared on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a long mean time of 2336s (median 201s), causing user drop-off when generation feels stalled.

waiting.headline: Setting Up Your Desktop Environment
waiting.body: We are assembling your pet's animations and desktop triggers.

guard.reason: Adding a visual time estimate and notification toggle for a real wait period is allowed under rule 5.

candidates.score_note: Helps long waiting drop-off with visual indicators and notifications.

candidates.title: Quick Start Time Guarantee Copy
candidates.change: Update the story screen copy to highlight that adoption takes less than 2 minutes.
candidates.why: High drop-off on initial path choice (23.8%) paired with long mean duration suggests users fear a lengthy setup process.

story.headline: Adopt Your Desktop Companion in Under 2 Minutes
story.body: Bring an interactive pet to your taskbar in just a few clicks.

guard.reason: Updating story screen copy with setup time estimate introduces the pet without violating any rules.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy tweak targeting initial path selection hesitation.

candidates.title: Desktop Quick Controls Copy Refinement
candidates.change: Rewrite the home intro headline and body to explicitly explain desktop interaction controls like dragging, clicking, and context menus.
candidates.why: Finish step retention is only 64.8% (overall completion 19.0%) and support reports multiple inquiries regarding desktop pet controls.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready on Your Desktop!
home_intro.body: Click your pet to play, drag it anywhere across your monitors, or right-click for controls and speech options.

guard.reason: Refining interaction control copy on home_intro complies with all base rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support and funnel; simple copy edit for desktop controls.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Progress Estimate & Notification
candidates.change: Add an estimated completion timer and desktop ready notification switch to the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: Making custom pets often stalls or takes long (mean adoption time 1017s), leading to 35.2% drop-off in adoption and failed generation reports.

upload_photos.hint: Processing your photos usually takes about 60 seconds. You can minimize this window anytime.

guard.reason: Adding a time estimate and notification option during photo upload processing complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off step supported by support emails; progress timer reduces stall anxiety.

candidates.title: Two-Column Path Selection Layout
candidates.change: Switch the choose_path screen layout to a side-by-side two-column view comparing preset vs custom creation.
candidates.why: Selecting a path currently takes a mean of 514s, indicating confusion between the options available.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Adoption Path
choose_path.body: Pick a instant ready-to-play companion or create a custom pet from your own photos.

guard.reason: Updating choose_path to a two-column comparison maintains the requirement to offer both preset and custom paths.

candidates.score_note: Layout tweak simplifies path choice decision time.

lessons_next: Evidence for specific kinds of change is still thin, as no category has at least 2 tests yet.
Predictions were generally too high compared to noise-corrected results in Rounds 1 and 3.
Predictions were slightly too low in Round 4 compared to noise-corrected results.
The single test for 'adoption, new_flow' won (+2.7% after noise correction), but category evidence remains thin.
No clear effect was seen for 'adoption, redesign' or 'finish, new_screen' in their single tests.
